# weather-effects (vendored)

The seven canvas effects from https://github.com/oneamitj/weather-effects at commit `d19b774`, copied unmodified
(MIT, © Amit Joshi; see `LICENSE`). Each file defines one global class (`RainEffect`, `SnowEffect`, `SkyEffect`,
`FogEffect`, `HailEffect`, `WindEffect`, `SleetEffect`) that draws on a canvas: no network, no storage, no styles.
The page loads only the one it needs (`public/app.js`, `Plan.weatherScene`). To update, copy the new files over and
read the diff first.
